types.description: HDC S4 0 SAS male axial-screw insert, size 6; four numbered power contacts plus aggregate PE

document.title: Weidmüller HDC S4 0 SAS data sheet
document.pages: 1 exact identity; 3 electrical/connection data and PE; numbered arrangement in RockStar 2012/2013 B.118/PDF160

modelingNotes: S1: Exact manufacturer data sheet HDC S4 0 SAS, created 03.03.2026 05:07:51 MEZ, pp. 1 and 3, verifies order 1789960000, male pin insert, axial-screw connection, size 6, four power contacts and documented screw PE connection. The part is recorded as discontinued with availability until 31 July 2014; the sheet names HDC S4/0 MS as an alternative, not this type.

S2: Manufacturer RockStar catalogue 1282180000, 2012/2013, B.118/physical PDF160, at https://media.digikey.com/pdf/data%20sheets/weidmuller%20pdfs/rockstar_heavy_duty_conns_2012-2013_cat.pdf. Exact male axial-screw row 1789960000 = HDC S4 0 SAS is beside its own numbered arrangement with four positions 1,2,3,4 and a separate earth symbol. No numbering or construction is transferred from the later 1023220000 screw insert or a size-3 a1/b1/a2/b2 variant.

C./M. are authoring aliases for the cable and mating ends of each manufacturer-numbered contact. S2 B.111/PDF153 includes an axial-screw contact section/assembly drawing and S4/0-specific table: the conductor enters the same contact whose mating side admits the tightening tool. Together with the exact numbered arrangement and copper-alloy contact data this supports four independent paths C.1-M.1 through C.4-M.4. Explicit project links implement them; bus functions and metadata do not join separate poles or cross to another insert.

All four numbered positions are power contacts; this exact 4+0+PE order has no additional signal/pilot contacts. Terminal order is a documentation sequence, not an L1/L2/L3/N assignment, face orientation or direction of current flow.

PE is one aggregate authoring endpoint. Its required flag is a library connection-coverage policy, not proof of external protective bonding. Individual PE clamps/mating portions and metalwork bonds are not enumerated, so no C.PE-M.PE fixed path or central PE pin is invented. MATE contains only the four documented numbered contacts and retains partial PE scope.

Manufacturer source comparison: S2 technical table B.108/PDF150 lists S4/0 Axial at 690 V/80 A, but its overview B.110/PDF152 and exact order page B.118/PDF160 say 830 V/80 A. S1 exact sheet also says 830 V/80 A. These family 690 / exact 830 entries are not reconciled into an installed rating or invented revision explanation.

Conditional capabilities from S1 p. 3: DIN EN 61984 rated power contact 830 V, 80 A and 8 kV impulse voltage; UL/CSA 600 V AC/DC. These are not nominal supply assignments, conductor sizing or as-built suitability. No scalar terminal current or voltage is set.

Preparation fields are retained as source conditions, not installation instructions. S1 p. 3 power-contact section: 1.5-16 mm2, 13 mm strip length, 2-3 Nm, hexagon socket 2 mm; PE 8 mm strip and 2-2.5 Nm; separate generic torque 0.5 Nm. S2 B.108/B.111 gives S4/0 Axial SW3 / IS 3 KG tool, 13 mm and 2-3 Nm. Its PE row qualifies 8 mm stripping for wire up to 6 mm2 and 1.5-16 mm2 connection with cable lug. Tool-size and torque-field applicability remain unresolved; no installed preparation is selected.

Silver-passivated copper-alloy contacts, at most 1 mOhm contact resistance and PC glass-fibre-reinforced body are recorded by the exact sheet. Mechanical mounting and surrounding housing are separate; the type does not assert live-disconnection capability, enclosure protection or a panel bond.

S2 B.111/PDF153 documents the S4/0 power-contact derating curve using H07V-K16 and derating factor 0.80, and explicitly says signal contacts are unavailable. The 80 A nameplate capability is not a universal ambient/conductor operating limit.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four manufacturer-numbered power contacts 1,2,3,4 each expose cable/mating authoring endpoints, plus one required aggregate PE. Individual PE interfaces/bonds, clamp subdivisions and face-view orientation are unenumerated. No pilot or signal terminals are present in the documented 4+0+PE inventory. Source 630 V, family-table 690 V and exact-order 830 V remain distinct unresolved entries.
